scope: Official marking and filled answer examples on source pages 1–19, followed by the official 48-item equipment appendix on pages 20–45.

translation.handwriting_treatment: Original numeric examples, graph pencil dots, handwritten mark values and handwriting that crosses form borders retained. Explanatory handwriting is translated in immediately adjacent italic Korean notes so it remains verifiable. Colour words in observation cells were localized.
translation.korean_fonts: Embedded matching Noto Sans KR and Noto Serif KR, with original source Latin font resources and native technical fragments retained.
translation.source_discrepancies: Chemistry marking source has Yamada indicator and alternate A2 pagination. The supplied 2021 question and blank-answer papers show universal indicator. Both source wordings and page identifiers were preserved. Ambiguous first handwritten *2 tolerance bound on page 4 remains visible in source handwriting without a guessed numeric transcription.
